Volkswagen Considers Major Job Cuts and Plant Closures

Volkswagen is reportedly planning a significant overhaul that could involve cutting up to 100,000 jobs and closing four German factories. These potential measures are being considered as the automaker faces increased competition from Chinese manufacturers, US tariff pressures, and declining European markets. The company has not officially commented on the reports.
